acceptanceCriteria: A1: Two real linked worktrees in one Git common directory can register and observe each other with repository, WI, Contract, worktree, head, and execution-generation identity.
A2: Providers can publish exact staged outcomes and consumers can consume composable heads before provider closure; invalidated consumers are discovered before their related action.
A3: Conflicting resource reservations are atomic, duplicate-safe, generation-bound, and never treat corrupt or stale state as free.
A4: Impact events are uniquely identified, deduplicated, persisted, and recoverable without late events overwriting newer state.
A5: Wait, safe-pause request/confirmation/paused, resume/re-evaluate, and cycle diagnostics are executable; affected actions wait while unrelated work continues.
A6: Collaboration writes and reads are explicit separate operations; queries have no persistence side effects.

A7: Fixed Runtime 0.2.105 remains responsible for existing schema-2 lifecycle only; candidate Runtime collaboration operations fail closed when its capability/runtime binding is absent or mismatched and never silently ignore constraints.
A8: Exact composition verification binds target, participant heads, order, Contract/declaration identities, toolchain/configuration inputs, and execution result in an isolated temporary worktree.
A9: Composition precondition failure starts zero expensive verification processes; failures, timeouts, and interruptions persist readable records before retry.
A10: Head, target, declaration, or relevant input changes invalidate old composition conclusions; only proven unaffected nodes are reused with immutable receipt references.
A11: CLI, MCP, and human Outcome use one projection and distinguish implementation, composition pass, target merge, and cleanup.
A12: Ordinary single-WI lifecycle remains compatible and does not pay collaboration scanning cost.
A13: Real Git multi-worktree and concurrent-process scenarios, tri-language docs, governance gates, and cost measurements are present and reproducible.
goal: Allow explicit linked-worktree Work Items to declare dependencies and resources, observe and report real impacts, coordinate safe waits and pauses, and verify exact compositions before merge without adding mandatory cost to ordinary single-WI work.
intent: Implement evidence-bound cross-Work-Item visibility, impact reporting, coordination control, and pre-merge composition verification on the existing collaboration foundations.
outOfScope: ordinary single-WI mandatory scans or required collaboration declarations

scenarioCoverage.expected: Two real linked worktrees register and observe provider, consumer, Contract, head, and generation identities.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the real linked-worktree registration and read projection from both worktrees and compare identities.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A composable provider head can be consumed before provider closure and a closed state is not required for dependency satisfaction.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Publish a provider outcome at composable_head, read the consumer admission, then close the provider and compare the decision.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Concurrent conflicting reservations produce one owner and no stale or corrupt record is treated as free.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run concurrent reservation processes against one canonical resource and inspect the persisted reservation and loser result.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Duplicate, late, and replayed impact events are idempotent, recoverable, and cannot overwrite a newer generation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Persist duplicate and out-of-order events, restart the reader, and verify one effective impact with the newer generation retained.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Pause requested, acknowledged, safely paused, unavailable, expired, and resumed states remain distinct and durable.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise the coordination request state machine with a running action and resume only after fresh admission.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Dependency cycles are diagnosed and unrelated work remains executable while affected work waits.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Create a two-edge cycle plus an independent WI and inspect both admission results.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Installed Runtime 0.2.105 handles existing lifecycle only; collaboration actions fail closed without the candidate capability and do not write partial records.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run old-runtime compatibility/lifecycle checks and candidate collaboration checks with a mismatched runtime binding.

scenarioCoverage.expected: An interface-level composition error is found before merge in an isolated temporary worktree.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Compose real participant heads with no text conflict and assert the direct interface failure and target identity.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Changing target, head, declaration, or relevant verifier input invalidates the prior composition conclusion.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run a passing composition, change one binding at a time, and assert re-evaluation rather than reuse.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Only proven unaffected verification nodes are reused and reused receipts remain immutable references.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run a composition with reusable and affected nodes, inspect reuse reasons and source receipt identities.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A failed identity or dependency precondition starts zero expensive verification processes and persists the failure record.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inject a precondition failure and inspect execution counters and the readable persisted attempt.

scenarioCoverage.expected: CLI, MCP, and Outcome expose the same collaboration facts and repeated queries have no write side effects.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Invoke the shared projection through CLI and MCP in summary/full and three language modes, then compare digests.

scenarioCoverage.expected: An ordinary single-WI lifecycle remains valid without collaboration declarations or coordination scans.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run a controlled ordinary Work Item fixture and compare its lifecycle projection and observation counters.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Independent clones and cross-machine topology are reported unsupported, and cold/warm coordination cost is measured without claiming unproven benefit.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the unsupported-topology fixture and the bounded cost scenarios, preserving raw samples and unavailable reasons.

sources: existing ConcurrencyBoundary, observation ledger, CLI/MCP, and collaboration scenario matrix implementations
